title: Theme token cleanup: refine globals.css public surface hierarchy for light/dark/system, strengthen CTA contrast, remove one-off color drift on public pages
acceptance: Surface hierarchy explicitly defined in globals.css
Public pages rely on shared tokens, not one-off color-mix values
Light and dark themes both preserve emphasis and readability
CTA contrast strong on homepage, pricing, login, calculators
notes: Defined named public shell, card, subtle, hero, CTA, and dashboard surface aliases in globals.css for both light and dark themes.
Replaced public utility one-off background mixes and body background composition with shared surface tokens.
Fixed ThemeProvider so resolvedTheme updates when OS theme changes while the saved preference is system.
Validated with ThemeProvider tests plus homepage, pricing, login, calculator, and tire-pressure CTA funnel smoke tests.
